scope: Author source-comparison review, not independent release approval; historical major/whole exterior approximation only.

decisions.result: Single shallow concavity; center y26 versus colonnade ends y37 design units. Front curve sits ahead of brick/glass back wall. Not a semicircular U.
Tower centers at x ±35 with half-width3.5; main wing lateral limits ±50. Substantial brick beyond both towers retained.
Hall/drum at (0,12), within wing connection; circular profile is not repeated on outer wing ends.
Straight rear with brick-dominant grid and pale base, modest entrance. Tree-hidden lower central portion deliberately blank subdued N01. Not a mirrored colonnade.
Shallow green broad bands and neutral capped rectangles. No courtyard holes, invented equipment or surveyed roof-depth claim.
Brick, cream, warm stone, verdigris and opaque glazing families represented with editable face materials, no source pixels.
Columns, lantern openings and stepped front retained; closed single solid, no fake interior.

unresolved_limits: Exact proportions, bay counts, dome profile, admin-wing symmetry and hidden junctions remain inferred.
Rear central blank closure is uncertainty, not claimed lack of windows on the real building.
Flat shallow roof bands/pads are coarse substitutes, not detailed roof structures or measured pitches.
Photos/plans span multiple dates and do not establish 2026 condition or repair chronology.
No physical print or structural performance validation.
